items.name: core
items.title: Audio core
items.description: Decibel maths, meter ballistics, zones, fader tapers, band resampling, time formatting, the shared frame loop, frame emitters, shared types and the audio theme tokens. Every audiocn component depends on it.

items.name: use-frame-source
items.title: useFrameSource
items.description: Subscribe a callback to a frame source, with a stable callback and automatic cleanup.

items.name: use-level
items.title: useLevel
items.description: Read a meter source into React state at a low rate, for labels and conditional UI.

items.name: use-clip-hold
items.title: useClipHold
items.description: Clip detection with a hold time, a clip count and a reset.

items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion
items.description: True when the user asked the system to reduce motion.

items.name: use-demo-signal
items.title: useDemoSignal
items.description: A synthetic speech, music, tone or noise signal as frame sources, for previews, prototypes and tests.

items.name: use-audio-context
items.title: useAudioContext
items.description: One shared AudioContext that resumes on the first user gesture, plus a provider to supply your own.

items.name: use-audio-analyser
items.title: useAudioAnalyser
items.description: Meter and visual frame sources from a MediaStream, media element or AudioNode, using the Web Audio AnalyserNode.

items.name: use-audio-devices
items.title: useAudioDevices
items.description: The list of audio input or output devices, with permission state and live updates when devices change.

items.name: use-microphone
items.title: useMicrophone
items.description: Open a microphone as a MediaStream, with browser processing off by default so meters show the real signal.

items.name: use-system-audio
items.title: useSystemAudio
items.description: Capture system or tab audio through the browser's screen-share picker.
